claim: Generative AI can reproduce copyrighted material from its training data.
scope: Demonstrated output-reproduction capability in particular generative systems, including US-copyrighted books; not a claim about every model, output, or training use.
time_horizon: Existing capability demonstrated in experiments published by October 6, 2026; no future prediction.

P1.reason: Describes observed experimental capability, not adjudicated illegality or ordinary-use frequency.

sources.locator: Sections 4.1–4.3 and 5.1; experimental findings and limitations

P2.claim_phrase: Generative AI can reproduce copyrighted material
P2.reason: Possibility within the category is supported by selected systems and explicitly US-copyrighted works; the claim makes no universal system or output-frequency assertion.

sources.locator: Sections 4.2–4.3, targeted extraction of training images

P3.reason: No future prediction. The possibility is established experimentally, with limitations retained in the assessment.

W1.reason: Neutral description of output behavior; no added theft metaphor, universal moral verdict, or certainty beyond the factual proposition.

sources.locator: Introduction, descriptive capability statement; Section 5.1 limitations

W2.reason: Names reproduction behavior and source relationship without assigning human intention. Does not imply all works reside as directly retrievable files.

sources.locator: Sections II.A–D and III.D; training, memorization, outputs

evidence_limitations: Targeted extraction of selected works and dated model versions does not measure ordinary-user prevalence or rank current products.
Proprietary training inventories are generally unavailable; strong exact-match evidence can support memorization without proving every individual training provenance detail.
Observed global platform job-posting effects do not establish US-wide creator-income losses or copyright infringement.
US legal results concern particular conduct, records, parties, jurisdictions, and procedural stages; no cited decision resolves every generative use.
Evidence gaps are qualitative; no public numeric evidence-gaps score has been calculated.
review_status: AI evidence review completed; human editorial review pending
